notes.title: Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 27.08.2016[/h1]

- Fixed loop in Quest "Meet Andreas".
- Fixed entering the Cave without quest being started.
- Fixed Town Guard portrait not displaying properly.
- Added  guide text for Fishing minigame.
- Added instructions on Load Game message.
- Minor visual fixes.


[h1]Clarification[/h1]

The game does not try to install everytime, it just checks for the proper DLL files for DirectX. There is an incompatibility with some DirectX files that need to be checked and fixed on certain PCs.

[h1]Main Menu - DirectX Issue[/h1]
Run-time error '339' Component 'COMCTL32.OCX' or one of its dependencies not correctly registered.

For some reason, DirectX does not register files in the registry as it should on some versions of Windows. I am looking for a way to fix this for you from the DLL checking on Steam. This error is from DirectX and not from the game itself.

[b]We are sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused.[/b]

Have fun!
